text: Scott

en: {player}! The Champion of Hoenn at last, and I was here to see it. Didn't I say I'd be cheering?
text: {player}! Campionul regiunii Hoenn, în sfârșit, și am fost aici să văd. Nu ți-am spus că te voi încuraja?

en: I told you I was looking for trainers who could carry on what the Battle Frontier stands for. Here, take this.
text: Ți-am spus că caut Antrenori care să ducă mai departe ce reprezintă Battle Frontier. Uite, ia asta.
{player} a primit Permisul Frontier al lui Scott!

en: The Frontier is where the strongest Trainers of every region meet. Five halls, five Frontier Brains, and a place for you.
text: Frontier este locul unde se întâlnesc cei mai puternici Antrenori din fiecare regiune. Cinci săli, cinci Frontier Brains și un loc pentru tine.

en: My ferry runs to the Battle Frontier whenever you like. Your team goes along, and the Frontier keeps one record of your streaks and Battle Points.
text: Feribotul meu merge la Battle Frontier oricând vrei. Echipa ta merge cu tine, iar Frontier păstrează un singur record al seriilor și Punctelor tale de Luptă.

en: Shall we sail for the Battle Frontier now?
text: Pornim spre Battle Frontier acum?

en: Wonderful! Hold on to your hat.
text: Minunat! Ține-ți pălăria.

en: {player} sailed with Scott for the Battle Frontier...
text: {player} a pornit cu Scott spre Battle Frontier...

en: No hurry. The Frontier will still be there when you are ready.
text: Nicio grabă. Frontier va fi tot acolo când vei fi gata.
Însoțitoarea

en: Champion {player}! The harbour has been told to expect you, and I'm to give you this.
text: Campion {player}! Portul a fost anunțat că veniți, iar eu trebuie să vă dau asta.

en: {player} was given a ferry pass for Southern Island!
text: {player} a primit un permis de feribot pentru Southern Island!

en: There's an island far to the south that no ferry calls at, with a garden in the middle of it. The pass lets my ferry sail there for you.
text: Este o insulă îndepărtată, în sud, unde nu oprește niciun feribot, cu o grădină în mijloc. Permisul permite feribotului meu să navigheze acolo pentru tine.

en: Shall I take you to Southern Island?
text: Să te duc la Southern Island?
Minunat! Urcă la bord.
{player} a pornit spre Southern Island...

en: Welcome to Lilycove's harbour. The S.S. Tidal calls here, but she isn't taking passengers today. Please come back another time.
text: Bun venit în portul din Lilycove. S.S. Tidal oprește aici, dar azi nu primește pasageri. Vă rugăm să reveniți altă dată.

en: Of course. Come back whenever you like.
text: Desigur. Revino oricând dorești.

en: Where would you like to sail?
text: Unde vrei să navigăm?
INSULA DIN SUD
Battle Frontier
NICĂIERI
{player} a arătat Biletul de Vapor.

en: The Battle Frontier it is! Please come aboard.
text: Battle Frontier, deci! Urcă la bord, te rog.
{player} a pornit spre Battle Frontier...

en: Where would you like to sail?
I'm sorry, the Battle Frontier is only for passengers with an S.S. Ticket.
Navel Rock it is! A long way over the open sea. Please come aboard.
Birth Island it is! The sea there shines strangely at night. Please come aboard.
I'm sorry, Birth Island is only for passengers with an Aurora Ticket.
Where would you like to sail?
Faraway Island! It's on no chart of ours, but with this map the captain will find it. Please come aboard.
The S.S. Tidal sails for Slateport City. Coming aboard?
Ships out of Lilycove go a long way. Some of them cross the whole ocean to lands I've only heard of.
Oh! Word has come from the Battle Frontier: you've won a Frontier Brain's print. Then this is yours.
It's a pass for Navel Rock, an island far out in the sea where the S.S. Tidal never calls. Some say a legend sleeps there.
Prints from two facilities of the Frontier! The harbour master asked me to give you this, too.
It's a pass for Birth Island, where a strange triangle of stone stands on the sand. Nobody knows who put it there.
Three of the Frontier's prints! An old sailor left this with the harbour for a trainer like you.
{player} was given the Old Sea Map!
It's a faded chart with an island drawn on it that no other map shows. The captain says he can find it.
